notes.title: Fixed bugs!
Game update!
notes.content:
- The game added new words in the amount of 50 pieces, for the game mode with the input of words.
- Capsule images for the library have also been updated.
- The game engine of this game has been updated to a more recent version.

notes.title: Improve the game
notes.content: Now the player can choose 5 different fonts for the letters. To choose them you have to go to the game settings. Additionally, I added +1 achievement to the player was aware that he has the ability to change the font.
